introHtml: Tulip wine glasses feature a tapered bowl that concentrates aromas, making them ideal for tastings and wine-centric events. Bulk buyers choose tulip shapes for their elegant profile and practical grip, especially in stemless versions that resist tipping at outdoor gatherings. Decorate with screen printing or etching for a polished look that stands out at corporate parties or trade shows.
